description: Module-level dependency graph for the Graphenee framework. Edges are internal Graphenee dependencies only (Maven). To navigate into a module, read graph/<module-id>.json.

gx-util.description: Foundation utilities: hashing, storage, media conversion, callbacks, JPA specs, data faults

gx-flow.description: Vaadin Flow base UI components, charts, converters, event utilities — no domain knowledge

gx-core.description: Core domain model (JPA entities), services, security, DMS, SMS, i18n, AWS, OwnCloud

gx-core-flow.description: Vaadin Flow UI views and forms for all gx-core features (security, DMS, SMS, i18n, namespaces, domains)

gx-jbpm-embedded.description: Embedded jBPM 6 workflow engine — runtime engine service, task lifecycle, Spring Boot auto-config

gx-jbpm-flow.description: Vaadin Flow UI forms for jBPM task management (approve, reject, skip, assign)

gx-blockchain.description: Sawtooth blockchain HTTP client with cryptographic transaction signing via Retrofit

gx-workshop-flow.description: Reference/demo Spring Boot application wiring all Graphenee modules together

impact_notes.gx-util: Changed by anything that breaks storage, hashing, or callback contracts — affects ALL other modules
impact_notes.gx-flow: UI-only changes; safe to modify without touching domain logic in gx-core
impact_notes.gx-core: Entity/service changes here ripple into gx-core-flow, gx-jbpm-embedded, gx-jbpm-flow
impact_notes.gx-core-flow: UI changes only; breaking a form API may affect gx-workshop-flow
impact_notes.gx-jbpm-embedded: Workflow engine changes ripple into gx-jbpm-flow
impact_notes.gx-blockchain: Standalone — no internal dependents, safe to change independently
